item.title: Sunbeth – a very fast car with interesting brakes, a deeper dive into its numbers
item.description: Revenue: The numbers are not shy Revenue went from ₦40.3bn in FY2022 to ₦119.6bn in FY2023 to ₦510bn in FY2024.
